EM ranks first across all four tested conditional configurations: SciERC NER ($\rho{=}0.360$), CoNLL Qwen $N{=}16$ ($\rho{=}0.466$), CoNLL LLaMA 3-seed ($\rho{=}0.462$), and SciERC RE ($\rho{=}0.417$). This holds despite full-set rankings ranging from \#1 (CoNLL Qwen) to \#5 (SciERC RE).
On the full set, EM is diluted by trivial agreement: instances where all $N$ samples produce identical (possibly incorrect) outputs receive EM${=}1$ regardless of quality, compressing the signal's dynamic range.
On the conditional set, where the model demonstrably produces varied outputs, exact agreement becomes the strongest quality signal.
The margin over SJ is largest on RE ($\Delta\rho{=}{+}0.171$), where compound extraction decisions amplify output variability, and smallest on CoNLL LLaMA ($\Delta\rho{=}{+}0.002$), where all signals converge near $\rho{\approx}0.46$.

\paragraph{WNUT-17 full signal analysis.}
Table~\ref{tab:wnut} reports all five signals on WNUT-17 with full-set and conditional $\rho$.

\begin{table}[t]
\centering
\small
\caption{Quality estimation on WNUT-17 (Qwen, $N{=}16$, $T{=}1.0$, $n{=}689$). Cond: non-zero F1 instances ($n{=}334$). Full-set $\rho$ reflects binary success prediction; conditional $\rho$ measures quality gradation. LP's conditional $\rho$ is highest despite negative full-set $\rho$.}
\label{tab:wnut}
\begin{tabular}{lcccc}
\toprule
Signal & $\rho$ & AUROC & Cond.\ $\rho$ & Cond.\ $p$ \\
\midrule
VC      & .724 & .913 & .038 & .487 \\
FK      & .125 & .555 & .169 & .002 \\
SJ      & .089 & .517 & .288 & ${<}$1e-7 \\
EM      & .050 & .487 & .333 & ${<}$1e-9 \\
LP & $-$.410 & .219 & .350 & ${<}$1e-10 \\
\bottomrule
\end{tabular}
\end{table}
The full-set $p$-values are: VC ${<}$1e-112, FK $p{=}0.001$, SJ $p{=}0.020$, EM $p{=}0.194$, LP ${<}$1e-28.
VC's high full-set $\rho{=}0.724$ is entirely driven by the zero/non-zero boundary (conditional $\rho{=}0.038$, $p{=}0.49$), while LP's conditional $\rho{=}0.350$ is the highest among all signals on the non-zero subset, full-set correlations on high-failure-rate datasets conflate binary success prediction with quality gradation.

\paragraph{Cross-configuration selection analysis.}
Table~\ref{tab:cross_selection} extends the selection analysis to five additional configurations.
On LLaMA SciERC, where output diversity remains substantial (18\% identical outputs, 39\% unique), LP achieves the highest selection F1 (0.652) at $N{=}8$ but still falls within bootstrap noise of single-sample (0.646), replicating the gap observed on Qwen SciERC (Table~\ref{tab:selection}).
On LLaMA FewNERD ($n{=}32{,}565$, 3-seed mean), LP is the only signal with positive selection ($+0.36$~pp), confirming LP as the most robust selection signal across model families (Qwen FewNERD: $+1.39$~pp, Table~\ref{tab:fewnerd}). All structural signals degrade selection (VC $-2.39$~pp, SJ $-0.52$~pp), consistent with the Qwen pattern. LLaMA FewNERD degeneracy ($23.4{\pm}4.7$\%, 3 seeds) is higher than Qwen ($12.7$\%), illustrating the capability-diversity tension: LLaMA achieves stronger greedy F1 ($0.784$ vs.\ $0.748$, $+3.6$~pp) but at the cost of higher degeneracy ($+10.7$~pp) and reduced oracle headroom ($10.0$ vs.\ $12.4$~pp).
On CoNLL, 48--87\% of instances produce identical outputs across all $N$ samples; this reflects a ceiling effect (single-sample F1 ${\approx}$0.91--0.92) rather than signal failure, and selection analysis on these configurations is uninformative because there is little per-sample variance for any signal to exploit.

\begin{table*}[t]
\centering
\small
\caption{Best-of-$N$ selection F1 (macro, instance-averaged) across configurations ($T{=}1.0$, 3-seed mean). Best non-oracle signal per row in \textbf{bold}. LP is the only signal with positive selection on both FewNERD configurations (Qwen $+1.39$~pp, Table~\ref{tab:fewnerd}; LLaMA $+0.36$~pp). At $N{=}16$ on LLaMA CoNLL, VC achieves small but significant gains ($+0.28$~pp, $p{<}0.03$; see text below). CoNLL shows especially tight clustering where greedy already exceeds 0.90.}
\label{tab:cross_selection}

\toprule
Config & $n$ & Greedy & Oracle & SJ & FK & EM & LP & VC \\
\midrule
LLaMA/SciERC $N{=}8$ & 529 & .646 & .778 & .643 & .639 & .634 & \textbf{.652} & .633 \\
LLaMA/SciERC $N{=}16$ & 529 & .645 & .806 & \textbf{.649} & \textbf{.649} & .640 & .646 & .640 \\
\addlinespace

\addlinespace

\paragraph{Diminishing returns of $N$-scaling.}
Our $N{=}8$ and $N{=}16$ comparisons (Table~\ref{tab:robustness}) characterize the marginal value of additional samples for test-time scaling \cite{brown2024monkeys, snell2025scaling}.
For quality estimation, structural signals benefit consistently but sublinearly: SJ $\rho$ improves by $+0.047$ (Qwen SciERC, 3-seed mean) and $+0.032$ (LLaMA CoNLL, 3-seed mean) when doubling from $N{=}8$ to $N{=}16$, while log-probability is approximately $N$-invariant ($\Delta\rho{\leq}0.021$).
Structural signals use $\binom{N}{2}$ pairwise comparisons (28 pairs at $N{=}8$, 120 at $N{=}16$), but the $\rho$ improvement is far less than proportional, each additional comparison yields diminishing information.
This asymmetry gives structural signals a relative advantage in the compute-constrained regime: at $N{=}8$, SJ already achieves $\rho{=}0.431$ on LLaMA CoNLL (vs.\ LP $\rho{=}0.307$, $\Delta{=}{+}0.124$), and the gap \textit{widens} at $N{=}16$ ($\Delta{=}{+}0.163$) because structural signals continue to benefit from additional pairwise evidence while LP does not.
For sample selection, additional samples increase the oracle upper bound (more draws raise the probability of a high-quality candidate), but signal-based selection remains flat because the selector's inability to identify the best candidate is a granularity limitation, not a sample size limitation.
The practical implication is that $N{=}8$ captures most of the achievable quality estimation benefit; further scaling widens rather than closes the correlation-selection gap absent stronger per-sample selectors.

\paragraph{$N{=}16$ CoNLL selection: small but significant.}
While quality estimation benefits sublinearly from $N$-scaling, selection behavior at $N{=}16$ reveals a nuanced exception on LLaMA CoNLL.
VC achieves the largest gain over single-sample ($+0.28$~pp, $p{=}0.003$--$0.027$ across 3 seeds, all significant), with SJ, FK, and EM at $+0.22$--$0.23$~pp and LP at $+0.12$~pp (2/3 seeds significant).
These gains are statistically significant but practically minimal: oracle headroom at $N{=}16$ is only 2.5~pp, so VC captures approximately 10\% of the available headroom.
This reinforces the primary finding: even under the most favorable conditions (high baseline performance, more candidates, and aggregated multi-seed evidence), signal-based selection recovers only a fraction of the oracle headroom available.

\section{Bootstrap CI for Signal Comparisons}\label{app:bootstrap_signal}

Table~\ref{tab:bootstrap_signal_ci} reports bootstrap confidence intervals for individual signal $\rho$ and pairwise $\Delta\rho$ on SciERC NER ($N{=}8$, $n{=}529$, $B{=}10{,}000$, seed${=}42$).
The SJ--LP gap ($\Delta\rho{=}{+}0.155$) is clearly significant, the structural advantage reported in \S\ref{sec:qe_results} is robust.
The VC--SJ gap ($\Delta\rho{=}{+}0.019$) is not significant; these two structural signals perform comparably.
The SJ--EM gap ($\Delta\rho{=}{+}0.065$) is borderline significant, with the CI lower bound at $+0.003$ and upper bound at $+0.130$.

\label{tab:bootstrap_signal_ci}
\begin{tabular}{lcc}

At $N{=}16$ ($B{=}10{,}000$, permutation test), the structural advantage extends to FK comparisons.
On SciERC NER ($n{=}529$), SJ--FK ($\Delta\rho{=}0.147$--$0.160$, all $p{\leq}0.002$) and VC--FK ($\Delta\rho{=}0.138$--$0.188$, all $p{\leq}0.003$) are clearly significant across all three seeds; EM--FK is seed-dependent ($\Delta\rho{=}0.054$--$0.093$, $p{=}0.048$--$0.15$).
On CoNLL ($n{=}2{,}756$), all signals significantly outperform FK: EM $\Delta\rho{=}0.071$ ($p{<}0.001$), SJ $\Delta\rho{=}0.056$ ($p{<}0.001$), VC $\Delta\rho{=}0.022$ ($p{=}0.040$).

\section{Diversity and Selection Analysis}\label{app:diversity}

\paragraph{Output diversity quantification.}

401	\paragraph{External equivalence margins.}
402	The oracle-headroom anchors above introduce circularity, as a reviewer correctly noted: $\delta$ is calibrated against the very quantity it contextualizes.
403	To resolve this, we supplement with three externally grounded margins:
404	(1) $\delta_{\mathrm{SEM}}$: the bootstrapped standard error of single-sample F1 (0.43--1.33~pp depending on configuration), which represents measurement noise;
405	(2) $\delta_{\mathrm{practical}}{=}0.5$~pp, the threshold below which NER differences are considered negligible \cite{ratinov2009design};
406	(3) $\delta_{\mathrm{literature}}{=}1.0$~pp, the approximate significant-difference threshold established in NER evaluation methodology \cite{bergkirkpatrick2012empirical}.
407	
408	Results under these external anchors diverge sharply by configuration.
409	On LLaMA CoNLL ($n{=}2{,}756$), all signals pass equivalence at every $\delta$ ($p{<}0.001$), consistent with the near-zero selection deltas ($|\Delta|{\leq}0.1$~pp) and tight CIs at this sample size.
410	On Qwen CoNLL ($n{=}2{,}756$), no signal passes at any external $\delta$: selection F1 degrades by 0.9--1.5~pp relative to single-sample, which exceeds even $\delta_{\mathrm{literature}}$.
411	On SciERC NER ($n{=}529$), only SJ passes at $\delta_{\mathrm{SEM}}{=}1.33$~pp (the widest SEM bound); all other signals and tighter margins fail.
412	These external anchors confirm that the equivalence conclusion is configuration-dependent: LLaMA CoNLL selection is robustly equivalent to single-sample under any reasonable margin, while SciERC and Qwen CoNLL selection shows detectable degradation at externally calibrated thresholds.
413	
414	\paragraph{Multiple comparison considerations.}\label{app:multiple_comparisons}
415	Our primary selection analysis involves ${\sim}$20 comparisons (5 signals $\times$ 3--4 configurations).

\paragraph{External equivalence margins.}
The oracle-headroom anchors above introduce circularity, as a reviewer correctly noted: $\delta$ is calibrated against the very quantity it contextualizes.
To resolve this, we supplement with three externally grounded margins:
(1) $\delta_{\mathrm{SEM}}$: the bootstrapped standard error of single-sample F1 (0.43--1.33~pp depending on configuration), which represents measurement noise;
(2) $\delta_{\mathrm{practical}}{=}0.5$~pp, the threshold below which NER differences are considered negligible \cite{ratinov2009design};
(3) $\delta_{\mathrm{literature}}{=}1.0$~pp, the approximate significant-difference threshold established in NER evaluation methodology \cite{bergkirkpatrick2012empirical}.

Results under these external anchors diverge sharply by configuration.
On LLaMA CoNLL ($n{=}2{,}756$), all signals pass equivalence at every $\delta$ ($p{<}0.001$), consistent with the near-zero selection deltas ($|\Delta|{\leq}0.1$~pp) and tight CIs at this sample size.
On Qwen CoNLL ($n{=}2{,}756$), no signal passes at any external $\delta$: selection F1 degrades by 0.9--1.5~pp relative to single-sample, which exceeds even $\delta_{\mathrm{literature}}$.
On SciERC NER ($n{=}529$), only SJ passes at $\delta_{\mathrm{SEM}}{=}1.33$~pp (the widest SEM bound); all other signals and tighter margins fail.
These external anchors confirm that the equivalence conclusion is configuration-dependent: LLaMA CoNLL selection is robustly equivalent to single-sample under any reasonable margin, while SciERC and Qwen CoNLL selection shows detectable degradation at externally calibrated thresholds.

\paragraph{Multiple comparison considerations.}\label{app:multiple_comparisons}
Our primary selection analysis involves ${\sim}$20 comparisons (5 signals $\times$ 3--4 configurations).
Since all primary selection results are non-significant ($p{>}0.05$), applying Benjamini-Hochberg correction can only make these results more conservative, strengthening the ``no signal beats greedy'' conclusion.
The sole positive finding, the non-tied LP subset ($+2.9$~pp, $p{=}0.004$; \S\ref{sec:discussion}), survives Bonferroni correction over 5 signal comparisons ($p_{\mathrm{adj}}{=}0.020 < 0.05$), as noted in the main text footnote.
For quality estimation signal rankings, differences between the top signals (e.g., VC vs.\ SJ on SciERC) should be interpreted as descriptive rather than as statistically confirmed orderings, given the limited power of 3-seed comparisons.

\paragraph{When would consistency-based selection work?}\label{app:when_selection_works}
Our negative results are specific to fine-tuned models with constrained decoding on structured IE. Several conditions outside our experimental scope could restore selection headroom.

(c)~Ensemble or mixture-of-experts settings generate structurally diverse candidates by design, reducing instance degeneracy below the levels observed in our single-model sampling.
(d)~Tasks where the model exhibits systematic overconfidence (e.g., hallucination-prone generation) may benefit from consensus filtering, as disagreement among samples would carry more discriminative signal than in our well-calibrated fine-tuned regime.

\paragraph{Constant prefix cancellation.}
All $N$ samples within an instance share the same prompt and, under constrained decoding, the same absence of thinking tokens at inference time.
Any LP bias from the training-time thinking prefix is therefore a near-constant additive shift across all candidates within an instance, leaving within-instance LP \textit{rankings} unchanged.

\paragraph{CoNLL control group.}
CoNLL and WNUT-17 checkpoints were trained without thinking tokens (\texttt{enable\_thinking=False}).
If thinking tokens caused LP compression on SciERC, CoNLL should exhibit lower tied fractions.
Instead, CoNLL shows \textit{higher} tied fractions at both temperatures (86.8\% at $T{=}1.0$, 95.8\% at $T{=}0.7$) than SciERC (60.3\% at $T{=}1.0$), directly contradicting the thinking-token hypothesis.

\section{Log-Probability Score Compression}\label{app:logprob_ties}

Under constrained decoding, log-probability scores are severely compressed within instances, limiting per-sample discrimination (Table~\ref{tab:logprob_ties}, Figure~\ref{fig:lp_range_cdf}).
The median within-instance LP range is only 0.041 nats; we use $\varepsilon{=}0.05$ as an illustrative threshold to characterize this compression.
At this cutpoint, 60.3\% of instances ($n{=}529$, excluding empty gold annotations) have a within-sample range below $\varepsilon$, and 75\% of pairwise comparisons are effective ties ($|\Delta|{<}0.026$).
The CDF rises smoothly with no cliff or discontinuity (Figure~\ref{fig:lp_range_cdf}); compression is a pervasive regime rather than a bimodal split.
This compression is stable across seeds: seed${=}456$ yields median LP range${=}0.040$ nats and tied fraction${=}62.2\%$ (vs.\ seed${=}42$: $0.041$ nats, $60.3\%$).
Seed~456 uses a different subtask flag (joint vs.\ ner for seeds 42 and 123); the LP distributions are statistically indistinguishable (median LP: 8.37 vs.\ 8.20 nats; Mann--Whitney $p{=}0.55$); the subtask change does not affect compression.
For comparison, SJ has only 12.5\% tied instances at the same threshold; SJ's advantage over LP for selection is one of score resolution, not information content.

826	\section{MBR Decoding and Task-Specific Interactions}\label{app:mbr_discussion}
827	
828	\paragraph{Connection to MBR decoding.}
829	Our selection strategies instantiate minimum Bayes risk (MBR) decoding \cite{eikema2022sampling, muller2021understanding}: each selects $\hat{y} = \arg\max_{y_i} \sum_{j \neq i} U(y_i, y_j)$ with utility $U$ defined by SJ, EM, or entity overlap.
830	Despite MBR's success in machine translation \cite{freitag2022high} and its extension to summarization, code generation, and captioning \cite{jinnai2024mbr}, all variants fail here: despite positive within-instance utility--F1 correlation, selection gains are limited by instance degeneracy, the core of the correlation-selection gap.
831	\citet{eikema2025structured} study structure-conditional MBR decoding and find that standard utility functions degrade on structured outputs, consistent with our finding that consensus-proximity selection fails in IE despite its success in machine translation.
832	
833	\paragraph{Task-specific decoding interactions.}
834	The free-form ablation reveals divergent behavior across tasks.
835	On RE, LP selection flips from $-0.68$~pp (constrained) to $+1.69$~pp (free-form; preliminary, single RE benchmark), a reversal that spans all 7 relation types and is driven by selective variance reallocation ($p{<}0.0001$).
836	The win/loss ratio shifts from 36:59 (constrained) to 45:45 (free-form), with the gains concentrated on relation-dense instances (mean 3.3 gold relations).
837	This interaction does not generalize to NER, where selection remains negligible under both regimes.
838	This ablation uses a single seed (seed${=}42$); whether the RE reversal replicates across seeds and generalizes to other RE benchmarks warrants further investigation.
839	The non-tied subset ($n{=}210$) is partially reshuffled under free-form decoding: Jaccard similarity between the constrained and free-form non-tied sets is 0.472: 87 instances newly gain LP discrimination while others lose it, and the newly non-tied subset shows a $3{\times}$ increase in within-instance LP range for the newly non-tied subset.
840	Despite this reshuffling, aggregate NER selection gains remain negligible. Score compression is not a fixed property of specific instances but rather a pervasive regime that shifts across instances without producing net selection improvement.
841	Free-form decoding also slightly improves quality estimation (NER VC $\rho$: 0.379$\to$0.409), though this does not translate to selection gains.

As a continuous complement to the binary tied/non-tied analysis, pooled within-instance $\rho(\text{LP}, \text{F1}){=}0.248$ across all instances confirms weak but positive per-sample signal; however, only 21.6\% of instances achieve $p{<}0.05$ significance, and $\rho(\text{LP range}, \text{F1 range}){=}0.328$ shows that instances with more LP spread also exhibit more F1 variability. LP carries information, but compression limits its exploitation.
A free-form NER decoding ablation (Appendix~\ref{app:freeform_ablation}) confirms this compression persists without constrained decoding.

\paragraph{$\varepsilon$ sensitivity sweep (post-hoc exploratory).}
Table~\ref{tab:epsilon_sweep} sweeps the tied/non-tied threshold from $\varepsilon{=}0.01$ to $0.20$ as a post-hoc exploratory analysis characterizing how selection gain varies with compression severity.
The tied fraction increases smoothly with no cliff or discontinuity, and the selection gain $\Delta$ grows monotonically as the non-tied subset narrows to progressively higher-spread instances.
$\varepsilon{=}0.05$ yields the strongest statistical separation ($p{=}0.004$); at $\varepsilon{\geq}0.15$, the non-tied subset becomes too small for reliable inference ($n{\leq}36$).

The preceding analysis stratifies LP by a tied/non-tied threshold; consistency-based signals (SJ, FK, VC, EM) also use $\varepsilon$ to define MBR-style proximity in selection.
Table~\ref{tab:epsilon_robustness} reports the maximum selection F1 variation across $\varepsilon \in [0, 0.2]$ for all signals and configurations.
At $\varepsilon{=}0.05$, consistency signals change by at most 1.09~pp (mean 0.21~pp), with EM completely $\varepsilon$-invariant (integer scoring); LP is the most sensitive (up to 3.65~pp across the full range), as expected.
Spearman $\rho$, the primary quality estimation metric throughout, is a continuous rank correlation that does not depend on any discretization threshold; the $\varepsilon$ parameter affects only the selection analysis.

Table~\ref{tab:within_rho} reports median within-instance $\rho(\text{LP}, \text{F1})$ across datasets, computed over non-degenerate instances (those with ${\geq}2$ distinct F1 values across $N{=}8$ samples).
Few-NERD exhibits substantially stronger alignment ($\rho{=}0.667$) than SciERC ($\rho{=}0.262$), directly explaining why LP selection succeeds only on Few-NERD.

\section{Consistency-Stratified Selection Analysis}\label{app:vc_quartile}

Table~\ref{tab:vc_quartile} stratifies SciERC instances by voting confidence (VC) quartiles and reports selection $\Delta$ (gain over single-sample) for LP and SJ.

\label{tab:vc_quartile}
\begin{tabular}{lcccc}
\toprule

\midrule

The NER pattern reveals two complementary failure modes rather than a monotonic relationship between consistency and selection gain:
\begin{itemize}
\item \textbf{Q4 ceiling effect.} High-consistency instances (mean VC${=}0.92$) have oracle headroom of only 4.78~pp. Samples have already converged, leaving little room for any signal to improve selection.
\item \textbf{Q1--Q2 noise.} Low-consistency instances retain large headroom (14--17~pp) but LP rankings are unreliable, and LP rankings produce inconsistent $\Delta$ signs across quartiles.
\end{itemize}

On $^\dagger$RE, the pattern differs: Q4 LP achieves $+4.01$~pp; LP may recover selection ability when high consistency coincides with structured output diversity. This is a single-dataset observation and should be interpreted cautiously.

On CoNLL NER, Q3--Q4 instances have VC${=}1.0$ (all samples identical), and $\Delta{=}0$ universally; this ceiling effect is even more extreme than SciERC Q4.

\section{Exploratory Extension to Relation Extraction}\label{app:re_extension}

We extend the NER evaluation to relation extraction (RE) on SciERC as an exploratory single-benchmark analysis.
RE produces sets of (head, relation, tail) triples with partial overlap; 40\% of RE instances receive zero F1, and entity span errors account for 55.5\% of RE false negatives, a prerequisite failure that consistency signals cannot detect (\S\ref{app:additional}).
All RE results use Qwen3-8B unless noted; single-seed ($\text{seed}{=}42$) for $N{=}8$ analyses, 3-seed for $N{=}16$.

\paragraph{Quality estimation.}
RE quality estimation is reported in Table~\ref{tab:multiseed} (3-seed means).
The signal ranking differs from NER: VC leads ($\rho{=}0.309{\pm}0.024$), but LP rises to \#2 ($\rho{=}0.297{\pm}0.022$), above FK, SJ, and EM, a reversal reflecting RE's higher sensitivity to per-sample scoring.
RE miscalibration is more severe than NER (ECE 0.109--0.339; Figure~\ref{fig:reliability}).

\paragraph{Selection.}
Table~\ref{tab:re_cond_selection} presents RE selection at $N{=}8$: no signal outperforms single-sample (0.404) on the full set ($n{=}397$) or the non-zero subset ($n{=}238$), with 18.1~pp of unrealized oracle headroom.
At $N{=}16$ (Qwen3-4B, Table~\ref{tab:re_n16_selection}), LP is the sole positive signal ($\Delta{=}{+}0.7$~pp, $p{=}0.058$), consistent with LP being the strongest RE selection signal across scales.

\paragraph{Scale ablation.}
At 4B scale (Qwen3-4B, $N{=}8$, $\text{seed}{=}42$), RE quality estimation shows FK $\rho{=}0.359$ and LP $\rho{=}0.351$, both above their 8B counterparts (FK 0.275, LP 0.266), while SJ declines ($0.267$ vs.\ $0.250$).
Selection remains below single-sample on RE ($\Delta$ up to $-3.4$~pp) despite 17.1~pp of oracle headroom.

\paragraph{Free-form decoding.}
RE LP selection consistently reverses direction under free-form decoding ($+1.8{\pm}0.1$~pp across 4 seeds vs.\ $-0.9$~pp under constrained decoding at 8B; \S\ref{app:freeform_ablation}); constrained decoding's fixed template likely obscures LP signal in RE (\S\ref{app:mbr_discussion}).

\subsection{RE Conditional Selection}\label{app:re_conditional_selection}

Table~\ref{tab:re_cond_selection} extends the selection analysis to the RE non-zero F1 subset.
Of $n{=}397$ RE instances, 238 (60\%) have non-zero F1 and 159 (40\%) have zero F1.
All five signals underperform single-sample on both subsets.
On the non-zero subset, selection performance is \textit{worse} than on the full set (e.g., VC: $-10.0$~pp on non-zero vs.\ $-4.5$~pp on full set), because single-sample is already strong on non-zero instances (F1${=}0.674$) and signals actively select inferior samples.
Oracle headroom exists (0.757 vs.\ 0.674) but no signal exploits it, ruling out the 40\% zero-F1 floor effect as the explanation for RE selection failure.

Table~\ref{tab:re_n16_selection} extends the selection analysis to RE at $N{=}16$ with 3-seed statistics.

\section{MBR Decoding and Task-Specific Interactions}\label{app:mbr_discussion}

\paragraph{Connection to MBR decoding.}
Our selection strategies instantiate minimum Bayes risk (MBR) decoding \cite{eikema2022sampling, muller2021understanding}: each selects $\hat{y} = \arg\max_{y_i} \sum_{j \neq i} U(y_i, y_j)$ with utility $U$ defined by SJ, EM, or entity overlap.
Despite MBR's success in machine translation \cite{freitag2022high} and its extension to summarization, code generation, and captioning \cite{jinnai2024mbr}, all variants fail here: despite positive within-instance utility--F1 correlation, selection gains are limited by instance degeneracy, the core of the correlation-selection gap.
\citet{eikema2025structured} study structure-conditional MBR decoding and find that standard utility functions degrade on structured outputs, consistent with our finding that consensus-proximity selection fails in IE despite its success in machine translation.

\paragraph{Task-specific decoding interactions.}
The free-form ablation reveals divergent behavior across tasks.
On RE, LP selection flips from $-0.68$~pp (constrained) to $+1.69$~pp (free-form; preliminary, single RE benchmark), a reversal that spans all 7 relation types and is driven by selective variance reallocation ($p{<}0.0001$).
The win/loss ratio shifts from 36:59 (constrained) to 45:45 (free-form), with the gains concentrated on relation-dense instances (mean 3.3 gold relations).
This interaction does not generalize to NER, where selection remains negligible under both regimes.
This ablation uses a single seed (seed${=}42$); whether the RE reversal replicates across seeds and generalizes to other RE benchmarks warrants further investigation.
The non-tied subset ($n{=}210$) is partially reshuffled under free-form decoding: Jaccard similarity between the constrained and free-form non-tied sets is 0.472: 87 instances newly gain LP discrimination while others lose it, and the newly non-tied subset shows a $3{\times}$ increase in within-instance LP range for the newly non-tied subset.
Despite this reshuffling, aggregate NER selection gains remain negligible. Score compression is not a fixed property of specific instances but rather a pervasive regime that shifts across instances without producing net selection improvement.
Free-form decoding also slightly improves quality estimation (NER VC $\rho$: 0.379$\to$0.409), though this does not translate to selection gains.

\section{Free-Form Decoding Ablation}\label{app:freeform_ablation}

Table~\ref{tab:freeform_ablation} compares constrained and free-form decoding across four dimensions on SciERC ($N{=}8$, $T{=}1.0$, Qwen3-8B; seed${=}42$ shown, 4-seed RE statistics below).
Free-form decoding removes grammar constraints entirely; outputs are parsed post-hoc (parse rate 99.95\%, 4406/4408).
LP score distributions are nearly identical across regimes (Panel~A: within-instance std ratio $0.97{\times}$), and NER selection gains remain negligible under both regimes (Panel~B).
RE LP selection consistently reverses direction under free-form decoding across 4 seeds: $+1.84{\pm}0.12$~pp (seeds 42/123/456/789: $+1.69$, $+1.76$, $+2.00$, $+1.91$~pp) vs.\ $-0.68$~pp constrained.
The constrained reference ($-0.68$~pp) uses the ablation-matched baseline; the primary experiment (Table~\ref{tab:selection}) yields $-0.9$~pp on the same gold-filtered set.
Quality estimation improves modestly for most signals under free-form decoding (Panel~C), with the largest gain for FK ($+0.053$ NER, $+0.039$ RE).

[Reviewer 1 审稿意见]:

# Reviewer 1 — Round 1 审稿意见

**论文**: Strong Predictors, Weak Selectors: Diagnosing and Fixing Self-Consistency for Named Entity Recognition
**Venue**: EMNLP 2026 Main Conference (ARR May 2026)
**审查侧重**: 方法严谨性 + 实验设计

---

## 总体评分

**Overall**: 3 / 5 (Findings)
**Confidence**: 4 / 5
**一句话总结**: 扎实的诊断性实证研究，"correlation-selection gap" 的刻画有价值，但核心方法贡献（entity construction）新颖性有限，且存在若干方法论问题（test-set leakage、post-hoc 阈值优化、非形式化 bound），削弱了 prescriptive claims 的可信度。

---

## 官方维度打分（ACL ARR Review Form）

| 维度 | 分数 | 理由摘要 |
|------|------|----------|
| **Soundness** | 3.5 / 5 | 实验设计整体合理，统计方法恰当，但 LP-alignment gating 存在 test-set information leakage，ε=0.05 non-tied subset 为 post-hoc 最优切点，expected selection gain bound 缺乏形式化推导 |
| **Excitement** | 3 / 5 | 诊断框架有用（negative result 本身有信息量），但 entity-level construction 本质是标准 ensemble 聚合，新颖性有限；4B-8B scale 限制了影响力 |
| **Reproducibility** | 4 / 5 | 训练配置详尽（Appendix C），代码承诺 release，超参完整报告，但部分实验 seed 数量不统一（2-seed vs 3-seed）增加复现难度 |

---

## Must-Fix 问题（影响接收决定）

### N1 [critical] LP-alignment gating 使用 test set 构成 information leakage

- **具体位置**: §4.5 (Prescriptive Results), "LP-alignment gating" 段落
- **问题**: Gating protocol 使用 50 个 test set instances 估计 within-instance ρ(LP, F1)，然后基于该估计选择方法（construction vs LP selection）应用于同一 test set。这构成 information leakage：gating decision 依赖了 test set 的 gold labels（计算 F1 需要 gold），再用该 decision 评估同一 test set 上的性能。
- **论文自述**: "probe instances are drawn from the test set for simplicity; in deployment, a held-out validation set should be used"，但仍 claim "correctly routes all three evaluated datasets"。
- **为什么影响接收**: 这是 prescriptive contribution 的核心（Contribution 3），如果 gating 的 "correct routing" 是 test-set-informed 的，则该 claim 的可信度大幅下降。"Adjusted ρ scores differ by >0.15 across all dataset pairs" 是间接证据，但不能替代正确的 held-out evaluation。
- **建议修改方向**: (a) 在每个 dataset 上用真正的 held-out validation set 重新验证 gating，或 (b) 做 leave-one-dataset-out cross-validation（只有 3 个 dataset 但至少是 clean evaluation），或 (c) 将 gating 降级为 "illustrative proof of concept" 而非 prescriptive claim，并从 Contribution 3 中移除 "correctly routes" 的措辞。

### N2 [critical] Non-tied subset ε=0.05 是 post-hoc 最优切点，叙事权重过高

- **具体位置**: §5 Discussion (Table 6 / tab:nontied_main)；Appendix D.4 (Table 10 / tab:epsilon_sweep)
- **问题**: ε sweep（Table 10）显示 ε=0.05 恰好是 p-value 最小的切点（p=0.004），相邻切点 ε=0.03 (p=0.079) 和 ε=0.10 (p=0.034) 的显著性明显更弱。论文在 Limitations 中称 ε=0.05 为 "post-hoc exploratory choice"，但在主文 Discussion 中将 non-tied subset 结果 (+2.9pp, p=0.004) 作为 LP 携带有用信号的核心证据，还声明该结果 "survives Bonferroni correction over 5 signal comparisons"。
- **为什么影响接收**: Bonferroni 校正应该覆盖 ε sweep 的多重比较（7 个阈值），而非仅覆盖 5 个 signal。校正后 p≈0.028，仍显著但远不如 0.004 convincing。更重要的是，一个 post-hoc 优化的 subset 结果不应作为 narrative 的支柱。
- **建议修改方向**: (a) 对 ε sweep 做 Bonferroni 或 BH 校正并报告校正后 p-value，(b) 在主文中明确标注 ε=0.05 是 sweep 中的最优切点而非独立选择，(c) 降低该结果在叙事中的权重——作为 supportive evidence 而非 primary evidence。

### N3 [critical] Expected selection gain "bound" 缺乏形式化

- **具体位置**: §4.3 "Expected selection gain decomposition"
- **问题**: 论文给出 E[ΔF1] ≤ (1-d) · Δ_oracle · g(ρ_within)，其中 g(·) 被描述为 "monotonically increasing function" 但从未定义。没有定理、引理或证明结构。论文称 "This decomposition is consistent with the observed data"，这是 descriptive fit 而非 predictive bound。
- **为什么影响接收**: 这个 "bound" 在论文中承担重要叙事功能——解释为什么 SciERC selection 失败而 Few-NERD 成功。如果它只是事后的 curve fitting，其解释力有限。使用 "≤" 和 "bounded by" 的语言暗示了比实际更强的理论保证。
- **建议修改方向**: (a) 给出 g(·) 的具体形式并推导 bound（即使是 under simplifying assumptions），或 (b) 将措辞从 "bounded by" 改为 "decomposed as" 或 "heuristically approximated by"，明确说明这是 descriptive framework 而非 formal bound。

---

## Should-Fix 问题（影响评分但不一票否决）

### W1 [warning] Entity construction θ=2/N "tuning-free" claim 证据不充分

- **具体位置**: §4.5, Table 4 (tab:entity_construction)
- **问题**: 论文称 θ=2/N 是 "tuning-free across all datasets"，但没有展示 θ 的 sensitivity analysis。Appendix H.2 (Table 19) 仅对比了 majority voting (k=N/2)，未做 θ 的系统 sweep。如果 θ=2/N 是基于这几个 dataset 的性能选择的，那就是 data snooping。
- **建议**: 补充 θ ∈ {1/N, 2/N, 3/N, ..., (N-1)/N} 的 sweep，展示结果对 θ 的 sensitivity。或者提供 principled justification（如信息论或统计学依据）说明为什么 θ=2/N 是自然选择。

### W2 [warning] SciERC greedy F1 出现 4 个值，协议不统一

- **具体位置**: §3.2 (Evaluation Framework); Tables 2, 3, 4, 14
- **问题**: 同一指标在不同表格中出现 0.640, 0.644, 0.645, 0.650 四个值。论文在 §3.2 给出了解释（seed、epoch、filtering 差异），但这本身说明实验协议不统一。Table 2 用 "2-seed mean"，Table 3 用 "single-seed" (SciERC) 和 "3-seed means" (Few-NERD/CoNLL)，Table 7 (multi-seed) 用 3 seeds。为什么 Table 2 用 2 个 seed 而非 3 个？
- **建议**: (a) 统一 primary analysis 的 seed 数量，(b) 在 Table 2 caption 中解释为什么用 2-seed 而非 3-seed，(c) 考虑在所有主表中使用同一评估协议。

### W3 [warning] 3-seed 统计功效不足以支撑 ranking stability claims

- **具体位置**: §4.4 (Robustness), Table 9 (tab:ranking-stability)
- **问题**: Kendall's W=1.0 基于 m=3 raters，exact p≈0.028。论文称 "interpret with caution given low m"（正确），但主文仍以 "Signal rankings are stable across seeds" 作为 robustness 的关键证据。SciERC LP selection 的 σ=0.48pp（3-seed）相对于效应量（+0.04pp mean）极大，表明 SciERC 结果高度 seed-sensitive。
- **建议**: 增加 seed 数量（至少 5 个），或在主文中更明确地 hedge ranking stability claims。

### W4 [warning] Complementarity claim 基于仅 3 个 dataset

- **具体位置**: §4.5, "Construction and LP selection are complementary"
- **问题**: "Construction and LP selection are complementary, governed by LP-quality alignment" 这一 claim 以及 gating protocol 的 "correct routing" 均基于 3 个 dataset（SciERC, Few-NERD, CoNLL）。3 个数据点不足以支撑 general prescriptive claim。CoNLL 是 ceiling regime，实际上只有 SciERC（construction wins）和 Few-NERD（LP wins）两个 informative data points。
- **建议**: (a) 增加更多 dataset（如 OntoNotes, ACE），或 (b) 将 claim 降级为 "preliminary observation" 而非 prescriptive guideline，或 (c) 在 Contribution 3 中明确标注 dataset 数量限制。

### W5 [warning] 模型规模覆盖仅 3B-8B，claims 表述过于一般化

- **具体位置**: Abstract, Introduction (Contributions), §5 Discussion
- **问题**: Abstract 说 "fine-tuned 4B-8B models"（正确），但 Contribution 2 说 "diagnosing degeneracy and compression as the two blocking mechanisms" 没有限定 scale。Discussion 说 "degeneracy rises with model capability"，但证据仅覆盖 3B-8B。70B+ 模型可能表现出完全不同的 degeneracy-alignment trade-off。
- **建议**: 在 abstract 和 contributions 中加入 "within the 3B-8B range" 的限定。

---

## 小问题（不影响接收）

- **Table D.1 (diversity) "Identical" vs 正文 "Constant F1"**: 概念不同（11% vs 17.8% on SciERC），但容易混淆。建议在 Table D.1 caption 中说明与 degeneracy 定义的区别。
- **Table 4 (entity construction) 缺少 multi-seed ±σ**: Tables 2-3 报告了 ±σ，但 Table 4 没有。补充有助于一致性。
- **WNUT-17 under-analyzed**: Introduction 将其定位为 "signal-collapse boundary"，但在主文中几乎没有出现（仅在 §4.2 提及一句）。建议删除 Introduction 中的角色定位，或在主文中加入适当分析。
- **Figure 1 caption ρ=0.39 vs abstract ρ=0.45**: Figure 1 caption 说 "ρ up to 0.39"，abstract 说 "ρ up to 0.45"。这是因为 Figure 1 只展示 SciERC 而 abstract 覆盖所有 dataset，但对于 "Overview" figure 这一不一致令人困惑。建议在 caption 中说明 scope。
- **Appendix 体量过大**: 1525 行 appendix vs ~220 行主文（不含 table/figure），比例约 7:1。部分分析的信息量有限（如 SJ normalizer comparison Δρ<0.01）。建议精简。

---

## Questions（需要作者澄清）

**Q1**: Table 2 使用 "2-seed mean" 而 Table 3/7 使用 "3-seed"，为什么 selection analysis 的 seed 数量少于 QE analysis？是否有特定原因排除了第 3 个 seed？

**Q2**: Entity construction 的 θ=2/N 是如何确定的？是在看到实验结果之前基于先验理由选择的，还是在多个候选阈值中基于性能选择的？

**Q3**: LP-alignment gating 的 within-instance ρ(LP, F1) 使用了 test set gold labels。如果改用 held-out validation set（不接触 test set gold），routing decision 是否仍然 correct？能否提供这一验证？

**Q4**: Expected selection gain decomposition 中 g(·) 的具体形式是什么？是否有 closed-form 表达式，或是任意满足单调性的函数？

**Q5**: 论文多处使用 "macro F1"（instance-averaged），但 §3.2 evaluation framework 未详细说明计算方式。是 per-instance span-level F1 的 macro average，还是 micro F1？对于只有 1-2 个 gold entities 的 instance，per-instance F1 的方差会很大——这是否影响了 degeneracy 的定义（不同 entity sets 可能碰巧得到相同 F1 值）？

---

## Missing References

- **Minimum Bayes Risk 在 structured prediction 中的应用**: 论文引用了 Eikema et al. (2022, 2025) 和 Freitag et al. (2022)，但遗漏了 MBR 在 NER/IE 任务上的直接应用（如有）。建议搜索 MBR + NER 或 MBR + structured prediction 的近期工作。
- **Entity-level aggregation/ensemble 在 IE 中的先行工作**: Entity construction 本质上是 entity-level ensemble。应引用 NER ensemble 方法（如 Florian et al. 2003, "Named Entity Recognition through Classifier Combination"）以明确增量。
- **Selective prediction 在 NLP 中的应用**: 论文引用了 Geifman & El-Yaniv (2017) 但未引用近期 NLP selective prediction 工作（如 Varshney et al. 2022 已引用，但可补充 Kamath et al. 2020 "Selective Question Answering under Domain Shift"）。

---

## 主要优势

- **诊断框架设计精良**: "Correlation-selection gap" 概念清晰，instance degeneracy 和 LP compression 的双因素分析结构明确。将 QE 和 selection 显式分离是对该领域的有用贡献。
- **实验覆盖广泛**: 5 个 signal、4 个 dataset、3 个 model scale、多个 N 值和 temperature，消融充分（LoRA rank、epoch、free-form decoding、supervised combination、hidden state probes）。
- **Negative results 有价值**: 系统性地证明 selection 失败（包括 supervised combination、DeBERTa verifier、hidden state probes 均失败）比仅报告 positive results 更有信息量。
- **统计方法整体恰当**: MDE 的使用、TOST equivalence testing with external margins、bootstrap CIs 的报告，方法论意识强于多数 NLP 论文。
- **透明度高**: 论文主动解释了 greedy F1 的 4 个值、thinking token confound、epoch confound 等，尽管这些本身是弱点，但透明处理值得肯定。

---

## Overall Assessment

**评分: 3 / 5 (Findings)**
**Confidence: 4 / 5**

这是一篇扎实的诊断性实证研究。"Correlation-selection gap" 的系统刻画对理解 self-consistency 在 structured prediction 中的局限性有真实贡献。但 prescriptive 部分（entity construction + gating）存在方法论问题（N1: test-set leakage, N2: post-hoc threshold, N3: informal bound），且 entity-level construction 本质是标准 ensemble 聚合，新颖性有限。如果作者能修复 N1-N3 并将 prescriptive claims 调整到与证据匹配的强度，可以是一篇好的 Findings 论文。Conference main track 需要更强的方法贡献或更广的 scale 覆盖（70B+）。

**论文**: Strong Predictors, Weak Selectors: Diagnosing and Fixing Self-Consistency for Named Entity Recognition

**Overall**: 3 / 5 (Findings)

| 维度 | 分数 | 理由摘要 |
|------|------|----------|
| **Soundness** | 3.5 / 5 | 实验设计整体合理，统计方法恰当，但 LP-alignment gating 存在 test-set information leakage，ε=0.05 non-tied subset 为 post-hoc 最优切点，expected selection gain bound 缺乏形式化推导 |

---

## Must-Fix 问题（影响接收决定）

### N1 [critical] LP-alignment gating 使用 test set 构成 information leakage

- **具体位置**: §4.5 (Prescriptive Results), "LP-alignment gating" 段落
- **问题**: Gating protocol 使用 50 个 test set instances 估计 within-instance ρ(LP, F1)，然后基于该估计选择方法（construction vs LP selection）应用于同一 test set。这构成 information leakage：gating decision 依赖了 test set 的 gold labels（计算 F1 需要 gold），再用该 decision 评估同一 test set 上的性能。
- **论文自述**: "probe instances are drawn from the test set for simplicity; in deployment, a held-out validation set should be used"，但仍 claim "correctly routes all three evaluated datasets"。
- **为什么影响接收**: 这是 prescriptive contribution 的核心（Contribution 3），如果 gating 的 "correct routing" 是 test-set-informed 的，则该 claim 的可信度大幅下降。"Adjusted ρ scores differ by >0.15 across all dataset pairs" 是间接证据，但不能替代正确的 held-out evaluation。
- **建议修改方向**: (a) 在每个 dataset 上用真正的 held-out validation set 重新验证 gating，或 (b) 做 leave-one-dataset-out cross-validation（只有 3 个 dataset 但至少是 clean evaluation），或 (c) 将 gating 降级为 "illustrative proof of concept" 而非 prescriptive claim，并从 Contribution 3 中移除 "correctly routes" 的措辞。

### N2 [critical] Non-tied subset ε=0.05 是 post-hoc 最优切点，叙事权重过高

- **具体位置**: §5 Discussion (Table 6 / tab:nontied_main)；Appendix D.4 (Table 10 / tab:epsilon_sweep)
- **问题**: ε sweep（Table 10）显示 ε=0.05 恰好是 p-value 最小的切点（p=0.004），相邻切点 ε=0.03 (p=0.079) 和 ε=0.10 (p=0.034) 的显著性明显更弱。论文在 Limitations 中称 ε=0.05 为 "post-hoc exploratory choice"，但在主文 Discussion 中将 non-tied subset 结果 (+2.9pp, p=0.004) 作为 LP 携带有用信号的核心证据，还声明该结果 "survives Bonferroni correction over 5 signal comparisons"。
- **为什么影响接收**: Bonferroni 校正应该覆盖 ε sweep 的多重比较（7 个阈值），而非仅覆盖 5 个 signal。校正后 p≈0.028，仍显著但远不如 0.004 convincing。更重要的是，一个 post-hoc 优化的 subset 结果不应作为 narrative 的支柱。
- **建议修改方向**: (a) 对 ε sweep 做 Bonferroni 或 BH 校正并报告校正后 p-value，(b) 在主文中明确标注 ε=0.05 是 sweep 中的最优切点而非独立选择，(c) 降低该结果在叙事中的权重——作为 supportive evidence 而非 primary evidence。

### N3 [critical] Expected selection gain "bound" 缺乏形式化

- **具体位置**: §4.3 "Expected selection gain decomposition"
- **问题**: 论文给出 E[ΔF1] ≤ (1-d) · Δ_oracle · g(ρ_within)，其中 g(·) 被描述为 "monotonically increasing function" 但从未定义。没有定理、引理或证明结构。论文称 "This decomposition is consistent with the observed data"，这是 descriptive fit 而非 predictive bound。
- **为什么影响接收**: 这个 "bound" 在论文中承担重要叙事功能——解释为什么 SciERC selection 失败而 Few-NERD 成功。如果它只是事后的 curve fitting，其解释力有限。使用 "≤" 和 "bounded by" 的语言暗示了比实际更强的理论保证。
- **建议修改方向**: (a) 给出 g(·) 的具体形式并推导 bound（即使是 under simplifying assumptions），或 (b) 将措辞从 "bounded by" 改为 "decomposed as" 或 "heuristically approximated by"，明确说明这是 descriptive framework 而非 formal bound。

---

## Should-Fix 问题（影响评分但不一票否决）

### W1 [warning] Entity construction θ=2/N "tuning-free" claim 证据不充分

- **具体位置**: §4.5, Table 4 (tab:entity_construction)
- **问题**: 论文称 θ=2/N 是 "tuning-free across all datasets"，但没有展示 θ 的 sensitivity analysis。Appendix H.2 (Table 19) 仅对比了 majority voting (k=N/2)，未做 θ 的系统 sweep。如果 θ=2/N 是基于这几个 dataset 的性能选择的，那就是 data snooping。
- **建议**: 补充 θ ∈ {1/N, 2/N, 3/N, ..., (N-1)/N} 的 sweep，展示结果对 θ 的 sensitivity。或者提供 principled justification（如信息论或统计学依据）说明为什么 θ=2/N 是自然选择。

### W2 [warning] SciERC greedy F1 出现 4 个值，协议不统一

- **具体位置**: §3.2 (Evaluation Framework); Tables 2, 3, 4, 14
- **问题**: 同一指标在不同表格中出现 0.640, 0.644, 0.645, 0.650 四个值。论文在 §3.2 给出了解释（seed、epoch、filtering 差异），但这本身说明实验协议不统一。Table 2 用 "2-seed mean"，Table 3 用 "single-seed" (SciERC) 和 "3-seed means" (Few-NERD/CoNLL)，Table 7 (multi-seed) 用 3 seeds。为什么 Table 2 用 2 个 seed 而非 3 个？

- **具体位置**: §4.4 (Robustness), Table 9 (tab:ranking-stability)
- **问题**: Kendall's W=1.0 基于 m=3 raters，exact p≈0.028。论文称 "interpret with caution given low m"（正确），但主文仍以 "Signal rankings are stable across seeds" 作为 robustness 的关键证据。SciERC LP selection 的 σ=0.48pp（3-seed）相对于效应量（+0.04pp mean）极大，表明 SciERC 结果高度 seed-sensitive。

## Reviewer 2 — Round 1 审稿意见

**论文**: Strong Predictors, Weak Selectors: Diagnosing and Fixing Self-Consistency for Named Entity Recognition
**Venue**: EMNLP 2026 Main Conference (ARR May 2026)
**审查侧重**: 新颖性 + 叙事统一性 + Related Work 质量 + 格式合规 + 写作质量

---

## 总体评分

**Overall**: 3/5 (Findings)
**Confidence**: 4/5 (Quite sure)
**一句话总结**: 实验设计严谨、分析透彻的实证研究，但核心贡献（诊断 + entity-level construction）的新颖性增量有限，不足以支撑 EMNLP main conference。

---

## 官方维度打分（ACL ARR review form）

| 维度 | 分数 | 理由摘要 |
|------|------|----------|
| **Soundness** | 4/5 | 实验设计严谨：多种统计检验（bootstrap CI、paired sign test、TOST equivalence、Bonferroni correction），多 seed 验证，消融充分。少数统计问题（见 W2、W3）。 |
| **Excitement** | 2/5 | 核心发现在概念层面缺乏意外性：4/5 signal 是 instance-level 因此不能 rank candidates（定义性而非经验性）；entity-level construction 本质是 entity-level majority voting（已有大量 ensemble NER 工作）。 |
| **Reproducibility** | 4/5 | 训练配置、prompt template、超参数均详细报告（Appendix Table 8）；数据集全部公开可用；constrained decoding 工具已注明。代码承诺 upon acceptance 发布。 |

---

## Summary

本文研究 self-consistency 方法在 NER 任务上的适用性。作者评估了 5 种 confidence signal 在 quality estimation（QE）和 sample selection 两个维度上的表现，发现 QE 表现良好（ρ up to 0.45, AUROC up to 0.82）但 instance-level selection 普遍失败。作者将此命名为 "correlation-selection gap"，归因于两个机制：instance degeneracy（13–87%）和 LP compression。最终提出 entity-level construction（跨 sample 聚合 entity）作为替代方案，在 SciERC (+1.67pp) 和 Few-NERD (+0.88pp) 上取得显著改进。

---

## Strengths

**S1. 实验严谨度高于同类工作。**
多 seed 稳定性分析（Table 7）、bootstrap CI（Appendix Table 5）、TOST equivalence testing（Appendix Table 6）、外部 equivalence margin 分析、MDE 计算——统计方法论层面做到了高水准。在 NER 领域的 self-consistency/confidence 研究中，这种统计严谨度是少见的。

**S2. 系统性的消融设计。**
temperature（4 点）、N-scaling（5 点，N=2 到 32）、model scale（3B/4B/8B）、epoch confound（2–3 点 curve）、LoRA rank、constrained vs. free-form decoding、supervised combination、hidden state probes——每个维度都有对应消融，形成完整的证据网络。

**S3. 问题分解清晰。**
将 quality estimation 和 sample selection 明确分离是一个好的框架选择；correlation-selection gap 的命名虽然在概念上不够新（见 W1），但作为一个具体现象的操作化定义是有用的。

**S4. 负面结果的透明度。**
论文如实报告了大量负面结果（supervised combination 失败、hidden state probe 失败、DALS 效果有限、VerbConf 过度自信），没有隐藏或淡化。Limitations section 覆盖全面（15+ 条限制），这是值得肯定的科学态度。

**S5. 写作质量整体良好。**
无明显 AI 写作痕迹（无 em-dash、无 -ing phrase 结尾、无 "Furthermore/Moreover" 堆叠、无黑名单用词）。技术写作清晰紧凑，术语使用一致。

---

## Weaknesses

### Must-Fix 问题（影响接收决定）

**N1** [critical] **Entity-level construction 的新颖性不足**
- 具体位置：§5.5 (Prescriptive Results), Table 4
- 问题：Entity-level construction 本质是 entity-level majority voting：对每个 unique entity mention 统计跨 sample 出现频率，保留超过阈值 θ=2/N 的 entity。这是一个自然且直接的想法，与 ensemble NER（如 Xiao et al. 2025 EL4NER、Naderi et al. 2021 等已有工作）在机制上高度相似——区别仅在于 ensemble 跨模型聚合，本文跨同模型 sample 聚合。LP-weighted 变体相对 uniform voting 的增量极小（SciERC: +1.67 vs +1.54pp; N=16 时两者 converge），说明 LP weighting 的贡献有限。
- 为什么影响接收：这是论文的两大贡献之一（"Fixing" 部分）。如果这部分不具备足够新颖性，论文的 contribution 主要就是诊断性的负面结果，对 main conference 而言贡献量级不够。
- 建议修改方向：更清晰地 articulate entity-level construction 相对于 ensemble NER entity voting 的技术区别（例如：单模型多 sample vs 多模型，是否有不同的 diversity 特征？LP weighting 在 ensemble 设定下是否可行？）。或将 construction 定位为 "applying known technique to confirm it works"，但那就需要 diagnostic 部分有更强的理论贡献来补偿。

**N2** [critical] **Correlation-selection gap 的概念深度有限**
- 具体位置：§4.2 (The Correlation-Selection Gap), §1 Introduction ¶5
- 问题：论文将 4/5 信号是 instance-level（对同一 input 的所有 N 个 candidate 赋同一分数）作为 selection 失败的一个关键原因。但这是这些信号的 **定义性质**，不是经验发现——instance-level signal 按定义不能区分 candidate。论文在 §3.1 已明确指出 "This distinction is consequential for selection"，但随后仍将其作为 "gap" 的组成部分来报告，混淆了定义性限制和经验性发现。真正的经验性发现是：LP（唯一的 per-sample signal）也未能有效 select——这才是 gap 的实质，但它被 4 个 instance-level signal 的"失败"稀释了。
- 为什么影响接收：如果审稿人认为核心发现可归约为 "instance-level metrics 不能 rank candidates（tautological）+ LP 在 constrained decoding 下被压缩（已知现象，Yun et al. 2025, Schall et al. 2025）"，论文的诊断贡献将大幅缩水。
- 建议修改方向：在 framing 上将 instance-level signal 的失败作为 **背景/动机**（"4/5 signals are instance-level and thus cannot rank by construction; LP is the only viable selector"），然后将分析聚焦在 LP selection 为何失败的两个机制上。这样 gap 的概念会更有深度——从 "5 个信号都不行" 变为 "唯一有可能的信号也受限于 degeneracy 和 compression"。

**N3** [critical] **Gating protocol 的 evaluation 使用 test set 作为 probe source**
- 具体位置：§5.5 LP-alignment gating 段落
- 问题：论文承认 "probe instances are drawn from the test set for simplicity; in deployment, a held-out validation set should be used"。但这意味着 gating protocol 的准确性（"correctly routes all three evaluated datasets"）是在 test set 上 evaluated 的，存在信息泄漏。虽然 probe 只用 50 个 instance，且作者指出 adjusted ρ 差距 >0.15，但这仍然是一个方法论上的瑕疵。更重要的是，gating 仅在 3 个 dataset 上验证，且 3 个 dataset 的 ρ 差距很大（SciERC ~0.26, Few-NERD ~0.5-0.7），routing decision 的"正确性"可能只是因为差距足够大，而非 protocol 本身 robust。
- 为什么影响接收：这是 prescriptive contribution 的一部分（"how to decide between construction and LP selection"）。在 3 个 dataset 上用 test set 验证的 gating protocol 的 generalizability 存疑。
- 建议修改方向：至少用 cross-validation 或 development set 重新验证 gating，或明确标注这是 "proof of concept" 而非 deployable protocol（论文已部分这样做，但在 contribution list 中仍然列为贡献之一）。

### Should-Fix 问题（影响评分但不一票否决）

**W1** [warning] **SciERC greedy F1 值不一致，增加理解负担**
- 具体位置：§3.3 最后一段，跨 Tables 1-4
- 问题：论文报告了 4 个不同的 SciERC greedy F1 值（0.640, 0.644, 0.645, 0.650），归因于 "protocol variants: primary seed vs. multi-seed mean, 5-epoch vs. 3-epoch checkpoint, and gold-filtered vs. full test set"。虽然 §3.3 末尾有解释，但读者需要在多个表格间追踪不同的 protocol 才能理解数字差异，显著增加了认知负担。
- 建议：统一使用一个 primary protocol 报告 SciERC 核心结果，将 protocol variant 的差异集中在一个 appendix 表格中说明。

**W2** [warning] **Few-NERD 3-epoch vs 5-epoch 的 confound 未完全消解**
- 具体位置：§4.1 ¶2, Appendix §H (epoch_confound)
- 问题：Few-NERD 使用 3 epochs（其他 dataset 使用 5 epochs），论文的解释是 "earlier convergence"。这引入了一个重要的 confound：LP selection 在 Few-NERD 上的成功可能部分归因于更早的 early stopping 导致的低 degeneracy。Appendix 提供了 2-point ablation（3 vs 5 epoch），但 (a) 5-epoch LP 仍然 positive (+0.62pp)，说明效果方向不变，这是好的；(b) 但 SciERC 的 3-epoch model degeneracy 仅 6.4% 却 LP selection 仍然失败（−1.24pp），说明 degeneracy 不是唯一因素。论文的结论（LP-quality alignment 是主要因素）是合理的，但 Few-NERD 和 SciERC 之间的 epoch 差异仍然是一个混淆变量。
- 建议：在 Limitations 或 Discussion 中更明确地讨论：是否有可能在 matched epoch 条件下比较 Few-NERD 和 SciERC（例如都用 3 epoch）。

**W3** [warning] **Abstract 信息密度过高**
- 具体位置：Abstract（8 行）
- 问题：Abstract 包含 ρ=0.45, AUROC 0.82, +5–8pp, +1.39pp, p<0.001, 13–87%, ρ=0.052, 23 configurations, +0.88, +1.67pp, p<0.005 等大量数字。这使得 Abstract 读起来像实验报告的压缩版，而非论文故事的精炼概述。审稿人在 30 秒内难以从这些数字中提取核心 message。
- 建议：保留 2-3 个关键数字（如 construction 的增益和 p-value），将其余数字移入正文。

**W4** [warning] **Selective prediction 贡献的定位不清晰**
- 具体位置：§5.5 Selective prediction 段落, Contribution #1
- 问题：Selective prediction（基于 QE score 过滤低置信度 instance，80% coverage 下 +5–8pp）在 Contribution #1 中被列出，但这本质是 QE signal 的直接应用，不是本文的方法创新。任何能预测 instance quality 的 signal 都可以做 selective prediction。将此列为贡献会稀释真正的贡献点。
- 建议：将 selective prediction 作为 QE signal 实用性的一个 demonstration，而非独立贡献。

**W5** [warning] **模型规模范围有限（4B–8B），对结论普适性的影响**
- 具体位置：Limitations ¶2
- 问题：论文仅覆盖 3B–8B 规模的 fine-tuned models，且 Discussion §5 指出 "degeneracy rises with model capability"，暗示 70B+ 模型可能情况更糟（degeneracy 更高）。但同时，更大模型可能有更好的 LP-quality alignment，这两个因素的交互效应未知。论文在 Limitations 中承认了这一点，但这限制了结论的适用范围。
- 建议：在 Limitations 中增加对 70B+/closed-source API 场景的具体讨论（例如：closed-source API 通常不提供 LP，因此 construction 可能是唯一可行方案——这实际上强化了 construction 的贡献）。

---

## Questions（需要作者澄清）

**Q1.** Entity-level construction 中 θ=2/N 是 "tuning-free" 的，但 θ=0.5（majority voting baseline）的结果在 Appendix 中。能否提供 θ 在 [1/N, 1] 范围内的敏感性分析？θ=2/N 在 N=8 时等于 0.25，这比 majority voting 的 0.5 低很多。这个较低的阈值本质上是在 boost recall 的同时可能降低 precision——能否提供 construction 的 precision/recall 分解来验证？

**Q2.** 论文在 §1 中声称提供 "the first systematic empirical characterization of when and why LP-based selection succeeds or fails for structured prediction"。但 Yao et al. 2026 已经研究了 consistency-accuracy correlation for entity and relation extraction，且 Vashurin et al. 2025 (CoCoA) 结合了 confidence 和 consistency。能否更精确地界定 "first" 的 scope？

**Q3.** Qwen3-8B SciERC checkpoint 使用了空的 `<think></think>` blocks（Appendix §E）。虽然论文通过三个论证排除了影响，但这本身是一个不理想的实验设计。为什么不重新训练一个 clean checkpoint？

**Q4.** Within-instance LP-quality alignment（ρ≈0.26 on SciERC vs ≈0.5-0.7 on Few-NERD）的差异是否可能由 entity type 数量差异驱动（SciERC 6 types vs Few-NERD 8 types）？或者由 train/test distribution shift 驱动？

---

## Missing References

1. **Entity-level aggregation in NER**: 论文引用了 Xiao et al. 2025 (EL4NER) 作为 ensemble NER 的代表，但缺少对 entity-level voting 机制本身的更广泛文献覆盖。例如：
   - Ratinov & Roth 2009 讨论了 NER 的 ensemble strategies（论文在 appendix 中引用了此文但未在 entity-level voting 的语境下讨论）
   - Luo et al. 2023 (Zero-shot NER with ChatGPT) 中的 self-annotation + voting 机制

2. **MBR decoding for structured prediction**: Eikema et al. 2025 已被引用，但 Wiher et al. 2022 ("On Decoding Strategies for Neural Text Generators") 提供了 MBR 与 MAP decoding 在多种 NLG 任务上的对比，对 selection-gap 的讨论有补充价值。

3. **Test-time compute scaling 的最新进展**: 考虑引用 Muennighoff et al. 2025 ("s1: Simple Test-Time Scaling") 或 Qu et al. 2025 ("Optimizing Test-Time Compute via Meta Reinforcement Fine-Tuning")，因为这些工作进一步探讨了 test-time scaling 在不同任务上的适用性。

---

| 检查项 | 状态 | 备注 |
|--------|------|------|
| ACL 模板 (`\usepackage[review]{acl}`) | ✅ | 正确使用 review 模式 |
| 匿名 (`\author{Anonymous}`) | ✅ | |
| 正文 ≤8 页 | ⚠️ | 需要确认。正文包含 Abstract + 5 sections + Limitations，其中 Experiments 和 Introduction 都包含大表格和图表。内容密度极高，可能在边界。Discussion 仅 11 行 tex，Conclusion 仅 7 行——这些被压缩以腾出空间给 Experiments，说明正文空间非常紧张。 |
| Limitations section | ✅ | 在 Conclusion 之后，内容全面（15+ 条限制） |
| Ethics Statement | ✅ | |
| Responsible NLP Checklist | ✅ | 认真填写，无全 N/A |
| 行号 | ✅ | `[review]` 选项启用 |
| 缩写定义（Abstract 内） | ✅ | NER, QE, AUROC, LP 均在 Abstract 内展开定义 |
| 引用格式 | ✅ | `\cite` 和 `\citep`/`\citet` 使用一致（parenthetical vs textual） |
| 引用覆盖 | ✅ | 73 条 bib 条目，69 条被引用；4 条 orphan bib entries（eisenstein2023helping, li2025llms, naderi2021ensemble, sarcinelli2025local）不影响论文 |
| 引用真实性 | ✅ | OpenAlex 验证：64 条 verified，4 条 not found（可能为最新 preprint），5 条 minor mismatch（first_author 格式差异或 year 差异）。无 fake citation。 |

---

## 写作质量检查

| 检查项 | 状态 | 备注 |
|--------|------|------|
| Em-dash (—) | ✅ | 仅在 .bib 注释中出现一次，正文无 |
| En-dash 解释性用法 ( – ) | ✅ | 无 |
| \textendash | ✅ | 仅用于数值范围（4B–8B, 13–87%），用法正确 |
| -ing phrase 结尾 | ✅ | 未检出 |
| 过度分段 | ✅ | 段落长度适中 |
| 黑名单用词 (leverage/utilize/delve/myriad/plethora) | ✅ | 未检出 |
| 连续过渡词 (Furthermore/Moreover/Additionally) | ✅ | 未检出 |

---

## 主要优势总结

1. 统计方法论严谨度在 NER/IE 领域罕见（多重检验校正、equivalence testing、外部 margin 等）
2. 消融设计系统完整，形成闭环的证据网络
3. 负面结果的透明报告（6+ negative experiments: supervised combination, hidden probes, DeBERTa verifier, DALS, VerbConf, calibration baseline）
4. 写作质量高，无 AI 痕迹，技术表述清晰
5. Limitations section 堪称范例（覆盖全面、诚实、有具体建议）

---

## Overall Assessment

**3/5 — Findings**

本文是一篇高质量的实证分析论文，实验设计和统计方法论的严谨度远高于同类工作。核心问题（self-consistency 如何适用于 structured IE）有实际意义。

但两个核心贡献的新颖性存在疑虑：
- **Diagnostic**: correlation-selection gap 的概念中，4/5 signal 的失败是定义性的（instance-level signal 不能 rank candidates），LP 在 constrained decoding 下的压缩是已知现象。Instance degeneracy 的 operationalization 有价值，但概念层面并不 surprising。
- **Prescriptive**: entity-level construction 本质是 entity-level majority voting（well-known in ensemble NER），LP weighting 的增量贡献微小。

- 建议修改方向：在 framing 上将 instance-level signal 的失败作为 **背景/动机**（"4/5 signals are instance-level and thus cannot rank by construction; LP is the only viable selector"），然后将分析聚焦在 LP selection 为何失败的两个机制上。这样 gap 的概念会更有深度——从 "5 个信号都不行" 变为 "唯一有可能的信号也受限于 degeneracy 和 compression"。

**N3** [critical] **Gating protocol 的 evaluation 使用 test set 作为 probe source**
- 具体位置：§5.5 LP-alignment gating 段落
- 问题：论文承认 "probe instances are drawn from the test set for simplicity; in deployment, a held-out validation set should be used"。但这意味着 gating protocol 的准确性（"correctly routes all three evaluated datasets"）是在 test set 上 evaluated 的，存在信息泄漏。虽然 probe 只用 50 个 instance，且作者指出 adjusted ρ 差距 >0.15，但这仍然是一个方法论上的瑕疵。更重要的是，gating 仅在 3 个 dataset 上验证，且 3 个 dataset 的 ρ 差距很大（SciERC ~0.26, Few-NERD ~0.5-0.7），routing decision 的"正确性"可能只是因为差距足够大，而非 protocol 本身 robust。
- 为什么影响接收：这是 prescriptive contribution 的一部分（"how to decide between construction and LP selection"）。在 3 个 dataset 上用 test set 验证的 gating protocol 的 generalizability 存疑。
- 建议修改方向：至少用 cross-validation 或 development set 重新验证 gating，或明确标注这是 "proof of concept" 而非 deployable protocol（论文已部分这样做，但在 contribution list 中仍然列为贡献之一）。

**W2** [warning] **Few-NERD 3-epoch vs 5-epoch 的 confound 未完全消解**

- 建议：在 Limitations 或 Discussion 中更明确地讨论：是否有可能在 matched epoch 条件下比较 Few-NERD 和 SciERC（例如都用 3 epoch）。

**W3** [warning] **Abstract 信息密度过高**
- 具体位置：Abstract（8 行）

---

**Q1.** Entity-level construction 中 θ=2/N 是 "tuning-free" 的，但 θ=0.5（majority voting baseline）的结果在 Appendix 中。能否提供 θ 在 [1/N, 1] 范围内的敏感性分析？θ=2/N 在 N=8 时等于 0.25，这比 majority voting 的 0.5 低很多。这个较低的阈值本质上是在 boost recall 的同时可能降低 precision——能否提供 construction 的 precision/recall 分解来验证？
